name: Dreamscarred Press
body:
Some spells are specifically created to work better with certain bloodlines. Typically crafted to enhance an existing trait or quality, heritage spells have the side effect of granting that trait or quality to those without it. These spells work for anyone, however, and have since found their way into other cultures’ repertoire.

Table: Spells of the Blood
Name	Description	Level
Bloodfoes	Enhances prowess against kobolds, goblinoids, and giants or against an enemy that has harmed you.	alchemist 1, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner 2
Brightvision	Creature touched gains increased darkvision range and color definition to darkvision	alchemist 1, cleric/oracle 2, druid 1, inquisitor 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner 2
Bristleback	Covers one suit of armor in spice	antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3
Earthskin	Reduce physical damage by 5 unless it’s from an adamantine weapon	alchemist 3, cleric/oracle, druid 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3
Harden Steel	Makes a metal weapon or armor harder and more effective	cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3
House of Hospitality	Convinces all around you of your friendship	bard 1, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2
Inferno Edge	Wreathes a weapon or natural attack in fire, increasing damage dealt	cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, inquisitor 3, magus 2, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3
Keen Eyes	Enhances ability to detect secret doors	alchemist 1, cleric/oracle 1, inquisitor 1, sorcerer/wizard 1
Power in Numbers	Increases the strength of a group	cleric/oracle 2, druid 3, paladin 2, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3
Shadow Trap	Creatures a mechanical trap out of shadow-augmented illusions	bard 2, cleric/oracle 4, inquisitor 4, sorcerer/wizard 3
Shifting Blood	Creature touched gains a shapechanger’s ability to revert to normal form	alchemist 1, cleric/oracle 2, druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 2
Stoneburst	Imbues throwing objects with explosive fire damage	bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, witch 2
Song of the Woodlands	Music inspires your allies	cleric/oracle 4, druid 5, inquisitor 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 4
Wrath of our Fathers	Inspires rage in one target	cleric 3, sorcerer/wizard 4
